Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/Marrickville/Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 27 Barwon Park South.pdf

Clause 9.27.1 - zoning (land_use_zoning): The entire precinct is reserved SP2 Infrastructure (Classified 
Road)

Clause 9.27.1 - setback (development_control): Residential lots either contain a small  setback or no setback from the road.

Clause 9.27.1 - heritage (heritage): There are no Heritage Conserva tion Areas contained within the  precinct.

Clause 9.27.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and 
encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.27.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain single storey streetscapes that existing within the precinct.

Clause 9.27.2 - other (development_control): To support pedestrian and cyclist access, activity and amenity including 
maintaining and enhancing the public domain quality.

Clause 9.27.2 - other (development_control): To protect  significant streetscape s and/or public domain elements within the 
precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandstone kerbing and guttering,  views and vistas and prevailing subdivision patterns.

Clause 9.27.3 - other (heritage): There are no Heritage Conserva tion Areas contained within the  precinct.
